title: Correct multilingual calibration Session evidence documentation
rawUserRequest: Japanese capability is mandatory before release. If the comprehensive Japanese assessment finds a problem, record it, correct it in a separate complete Work Item, and only then resume the assessment. Every Work Item must use instruction-plan-implementation-acceptance traceability and complete PR, merge, closure, and branch cleanup.

declaredIntent.summary: Correct the trilingual calibration Session evidence-storage boundary and enforce it with executable documentation checks.

outOfScope: Changing calibration runtime persistence, Session schema, record-evidence behavior, activation, or rollback behavior.
Editing the paused final Japanese assessment implementation or reports.
Treating labels such as reviewer as proof of who performed review or that duties were independently separated.
Resuming documentation alignment, publishing a release, changing release metadata/tags/provider assets, or cleaning plan documents.
Applying every single-strategy readability suggestion from the Japanese review; only the consensus factual blocker is corrected here.

sources.reason: Contains the Japanese factual contradiction identified by independent Accuracy and Clarity review.
English peer contains the same early narrow storage claim and later full seven-column statement.
Chinese peer contains the same internal contradiction and must remain semantically aligned.
Runtime fact source showing record-evidence persists the structured checklistEvidence object in each stage; read-only in this Work Item.
Documentation metadata gate where the trilingual evidence-boundary marker and semantics can be enforced.
Defines fix-process-first, Japanese mandatory capability, and complete corrective lifecycle order.
Authoritative byte-bound inventory that must be regenerated because the installation guides and documentation regression are capability evidence.
Closed predecessor evidence proving the reusable scope dependency correction landed before this Work Item resumed.

riskAssessment.reason: Incorrect storage guidance can cause adopters to omit or duplicate evidence and would let a mandatory Japanese release assessment pass a false claim.

executionDecision.reason: The user already instructed separate correction of every Japanese assessment finding before release.

preReviewWarnings: Keep runtime behavior unchanged and derive documentation from ai_calibrate.py.
Do not claim reviewer labels prove who performed review or that duties were independently separated.
Keep English, Chinese, and Japanese storage semantics equivalent.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record checkpoints before implementation and finish to prevent multilingual or runtime-truth drift.

acceptance: A1: English, Chinese, and Japanese installation guides no longer claim that Session stores only answers or execution state; all three explicitly state that the combined stage record persists every schema-supported field needed for the seven-column review row, with answer fields and checklistEvidence stored in their schema-defined locations.

A2: All three guides distinguish Session facts from Work Item governance/external review context without claiming reviewer labels prove who performed review or that duties were independently separated.
A3: The contradictory early and later paragraphs are consolidated into one same-meaning storage-boundary explanation in each language, with a shared machine-readable marker.

A4: check_docs_metadata rejects a missing marker, a missing checklistEvidence boundary, a narrow Session-only claim in supported natural word orders, a missing reviewer-label limitation, or a prompt that loses the answer versus record-evidence storage split in any language.
A5: Focused multilingual documentation tests and metadata checks pass while calibration runtime files and behavior remain unchanged.

A6: PLAN-DIRECTIVE-043 lists the exact active Contract and Summary, all three installation guides, the metadata checker, its regression test, this corrective plan, and the comprehensive plan; make check-instruction-traceability passes before archive.

A7: The closed capability-evidence predecessor is source-bound in resumeHistory, docs/reference/capability-truth-matrix.json is in Contract scope and regenerated in the actual diff, and matrix regeneration is not treated as proof of Japanese capability behavior.
guidelines: Document runtime truth from executable evidence, not from a simplified mental model.
Keep trilingual storage semantics equivalent and actionable.
Separate persisted labels from external proof of the reviewer and independent duty separation.
Add an executable regression so the contradiction cannot recur.
Preserve the paused final assessment and later serial stages.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: A language says Session stores only answers or execution state.
scenarioCoverage.expected: Documentation metadata validation fails before merge or release.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Add red-first fixtures for the current narrow claims in English, Chinese, and Japanese.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: A guide lists reviewer or owner labels without explaining their trust boundary.
scenarioCoverage.expected: The guide states that labels do not prove who performed review or that duties were independently separated; missing boundaries fail validation.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Require shared semantic markers and language-specific reviewer-label limitation statements.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: The corrective accidentally changes calibration runtime behavior.
scenarioCoverage.expected: Scope and diff ownership reject runtime changes; existing calibration tests remain green.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run scope/ownership and focused calibration/documentation tests with scripts/ai_calibrate.py unchanged.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: The corrective has not completed its full lifecycle.
scenarioCoverage.expected: The paused final Japanese assessment, documentation alignment, and release remain blocked.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Require archive, exact PR Head, Hosted success, merge, closure, branch absence, and synchronized main before resume.

intent.problem: The mandatory Japanese final assessment found that all three installation guides understate Session persistence in an early paragraph even though later text and ai_calibrate.py show the combined stage record stores answer fields plus structured checklistEvidence. The contradiction can misdirect evidence ownership and invalidate a zero-blocker Japanese result.
constraints: Change documentation and its checks only; do not modify calibration runtime behavior.
Keep English, Chinese, and Japanese meaning aligned.
Do not infer who performed review or independent duty separation from persisted labels.
Correct only the consensus factual blocker; retain other review suggestions for the later alignment Work Item.
Complete the corrective lifecycle before resuming the paused final assessment.
intent.rationale: One explicit trilingual storage contract plus executable metadata regressions removes the current contradiction and prevents the same Japanese release blocker from returning.

restrictedWriteApproval.reason: No restricted policy path is required.

rollbackNote: Revert the three documentation paragraphs, metadata check, tests, traceability, and plan changes; calibration runtime remains untouched.
